mechanics.name: Deadline
mechanics.currentEffect: While injured, the chance of Skill Checks increases by 6/8/10% while repairing or healing. Skill Checks appear at random positions, and missed-check progress loss is reduced by 50%.
activation: Repair a Generator or heal while injured.
Ends/deactivates when: Effects are inactive when no longer injured or when not repairing/healing.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: When injured, you get more frequent, randomly positioned Skill Checks and lose less progress for missing one.
duration: While injured during repair or healing.

editorial.summary: While injured, Skill Checks occur more often and at random screen positions during repair and healing; failed checks lose 50% less progress.
useCases: Generate more Skill Checks for Hyperfocus, Autodidact, or other check-based builds while injured.
Use the reduced miss penalty to make deliberately difficult Skill Check setups less punishing.
Increase Skill Check opportunities during both generator repair and healing.
counters: Random Skill Check positions make execution harder.
More Skill Checks can be a downside if the build gains nothing from them.
pros: Unique way to increase Skill Check frequency.
Works on both repairing and healing.
cons: Mostly a synergy engine rather than standalone power.
analysis: Deadline closes this batch because increasing Skill Check frequency is valuable only when the build has a reason to want extra Skill Checks. Hyperfocus and Autodidact are the clearest examples, turning more checks into more opportunities for their own effects.

The perk deliberately makes those checks less comfortable by moving them to random positions. That raises the execution requirement and can cause more mistakes, though the fifty-percent reduction to missed-check progress loss softens the punishment.
Staying injured is another cost. The perk is inactive while Healthy, so a build that heals frequently may spend much of the Trial without its main effect.

Deadline is therefore a niche engine for people intentionally building around Skill Checks. In that context it can improve consistency through volume; outside that context it is mostly making the HUD more chaotic for no reward.
editorial.verdict: A specialist Skill Check accelerator. Deadline is useful when your other perks profit from extra checks and unnecessary turbulence everywhere else.
